markets.question: Who will win in the upcoming football event Fresno State vs Washington State scheduled for October 4, 2026 at 1:30 AM UTC?
markets.description: This market will settle to the winner of the Fresno State vs Washington State College Football game scheduled for Oct 3, 2026. Overtime is included if played. If a tied final score is reported and no official winner is declared, this market will not resolve automatically and will be reviewed against the official governing-body result. If the game is delayed, postponed, or suspended and not rescheduled to a date within two weeks of the originally scheduled date, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from the relevant governing body.
